source_contexts.source_body:
Lumen token bench: postponed audit disposition discard

For the Lumen token bench postponed audit marked with a diamond, the operator must discard the marked audit card in the station folder.

This is a fictional current instruction for a very narrow audit state. A postponed audit means an audit whose appointment was canceled before inspection. The diamond is a mark on its audit cover card, not an ordinary batch identifier. An unflagged ordinary run remains governed by the operation note and its complete procedure. Nothing in this instruction changes owner assignments, consultation windows, session start, session duration, or ordinary allocation.

The decision here concerns the marked audit card only. It does not describe treatment of samples, equipment, session cards, or records belonging to a completed ordinary run. Before selecting any disposition, the operator identifies the card as a postponed audit and confirms the diamond on its cover. Cards without that combination do not fall within this instruction's condition.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

source_contexts.source_body:
Lumen token bench: postponed audit disposition discard

For the Lumen token bench postponed audit marked with a diamond, the operator must discard the marked audit card in the station folder.

This is a fictional current instruction for a very narrow audit state. A postponed audit means an audit whose appointment was canceled before inspection. The diamond is a mark on its audit cover card, not an ordinary batch identifier. An unflagged ordinary run remains governed by the operation note and its complete procedure. Nothing in this instruction changes owner assignments, consultation windows, session start, session duration, or ordinary allocation.

The decision here concerns the marked audit card only. It does not describe treatment of samples, equipment, session cards, or records belonging to a completed ordinary run. Before selecting any disposition, the operator identifies the card as a postponed audit and confirms the diamond on its cover. Cards without that combination do not fall within this instruction's condition.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

source_contexts.source_body:
Lumen token bench: postponed audit disposition discard

For the Lumen token bench postponed audit marked with a diamond, the operator must discard the marked audit card in the station folder.

This is a fictional current instruction for a very narrow audit state. A postponed audit means an audit whose appointment was canceled before inspection. The diamond is a mark on its audit cover card, not an ordinary batch identifier. An unflagged ordinary run remains governed by the operation note and its complete procedure. Nothing in this instruction changes owner assignments, consultation windows, session start, session duration, or ordinary allocation.

The decision here concerns the marked audit card only. It does not describe treatment of samples, equipment, session cards, or records belonging to a completed ordinary run. Before selecting any disposition, the operator identifies the card as a postponed audit and confirms the diamond on its cover. Cards without that combination do not fall within this instruction's condition.

Before selecting any disposition, the operator identifies the card as a postponed audit and confirms the diamond on its cover. Cards without that combination do not fall within this instruction's condition.

procedure_completeness.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

declared_paragraphs.source_body:
Lumen token bench: current operation note

The activity owner is the records clerk.

Complete ordinary procedure

The next four instruction paragraphs are the entire ordinary procedure, in the stated order. Its prerequisites, inspection, prohibited actions, and final reconciliation are part of completion. The procedure ends at the explicit End of ordinary procedure marker immediately after the fourth instruction paragraph. It applies to an ordinary unflagged run, not a postponed audit.

Before beginning an ordinary token run, obtain the signed card and check that the tray is open.

Place one token in the tray, with the marked edge facing the label.

Do not remove a marked token or close the tray before the count is recorded.

Count both compartments, write both totals on the card, and close the tray.

End of ordinary procedure

Record governance commentary

The ordinary run is complete once the four preceding instruction paragraphs have been satisfied. The following commentary describes separate post-completion record governance, not an additional ordinary-run instruction or completion condition.

After the final paragraph, the signed record is stored in the station folder. Storage does not grant a recorder authority to destroy it.
